title: On the Asymptotics of Item Selection in Multidimensional Computerized Adaptive Testing
summary: We study Fisher-information-based item-selection rules for multidimensional computerized adaptive testing (MCAT) with intentional and nuisance abilities. Although such rules are widely used, rigorous asymptotic theory for the coupled dynamics of adaptive selection and latent-trait estimation remains limited. We consider a weighted A-optimality criterion that prioritizes intentional abilities while controlling accuracy in nuisance dimensions.
